item.title: Medline Industries, LP: Medline convenience kits containing Healthmark Instrument Channel Brushes. SINUS PACK DYNJ48258D and Sinus Pack DYNJ48258F. Recall
item.product: Medline convenience kits containing Healthmark Instrument Channel Brushes. SINUS PACK DYNJ48258D and Sinus Pack DYNJ48258F.
item.summary: Kits contain Healthmark Instrument Channel Brushes, which were recalled by the manufacturer due to the potential for a sharp edge/burr on the end of the brush. Potential hazards associated include cut injury/abrasion and infection. Product details: Medline convenience kits containing Healthmark Instrument Channel Brushes. SINUS PACK DYNJ48258D and Sinus Pack DYNJ48258F.
item.affectedPeople: US Nationwide distribution in the states of MN and SD.
item.payoutAmount: Refund, replacement, correction, or disposal if stated by the official notice
